Please cite:
Hiatt L, Weisburd B, Dolzhenko E, Rubinetti V, Avvaru AK, VanNoy GE, Kurtas NE, Rehm HL, Quinlan A, Dashnow H. STRchive: a dynamic resource detailing population-level and locus-specific insights at tandem repeat disease loci. Genome Medicine. 2025. doi:10.1186/s13073-025-01454-4

RNA-TR-Scout distributes a selected and transformed derivative of STRchive disease-locus information as part of its validated runtime catalog. It is not a complete copy of the upstream STRchive resource. RNA-TR-Scout-specific transformations, runtime identifiers, combined mapping targets, and validation semantics are downstream modifications and should not be attributed to the STRchive authors.
